svg.title: fin: three paper-trading arms on one news stream
svg.desc: Public feeds are polled by Rust Lambdas that publish NewsItem events on an EventBridge bus with a 90-day archive. Three arms consume the same stream: v1, a risk-gated serverless pipeline; v2, an Agent SDK investigator with no risk gate; v3, the same investigator plus a gated world model and a curiosity loop. Shared services: a deterministic price resolver over public market-data APIs, Amazon Bedrock models and Nova web grounding, SSM kill switches and budgets, a quote tape, private S3 transcripts. Observers (daily letter, dashboard, A/B report) are read-only. The replay bench re-runs the archive against a simulated book.
svg.text: fin — three paper-trading arms on one news stream (paper only: no broker, no real money)

Also the only news producer: every arm reads its pollers.

age gate · claim · dedupe · 8-K enrichment (Haiku) · triage (Haiku)

master model on Bedrock · built-in tools off · only the in-process fin MCP:
read_source · web_search · resolve_instrument · search_markets · portfolio
submit_decision × N · full transcript to private S3

get_world_model · record_fact · link_exposure

basin · price fact within 5 % of live · causal link judged (fails closed)

Yahoo Finance (unofficial) · Kraken · Coinbase

Amazon Bedrock

(bedrock:InvokeTool on the nova_grounding system tool)
Control plane

SQS DLQs · CloudWatch alarms → SNS email

DynamoDB <prefix>-quote-tape
QUOTE#<symbol> / TS# · MARKET#<slug> / TS#
EVENT#<news_id> / SNAP — item, triage, symbols
stamped at observation time · TTL 90 days
read by the bench; never written by it
Observers — read-only, never in the decision path
daily letter (daily-report.ts + letter.ts + performance.ts; PDF printing is opt-in) · local dashboard on 127.0.0.1 (dashboard.ts) · A/B report across arms (report.ts)
outcome scorer (score.ts): every action, holds included, scored at 1 h / 1 d / 7 d against realized round-trip prices
everything marks positions at liquidation value — the bid for longs, the ask for shorts — and the letter, dashboard, scorer and watcher agree
